Apple to Alter App Data Consent Rules Following German Regulator's Directive

Apple has agreed to modify its app data consent rules, according to a German regulator. The company will implement changes to how users grant permission for app data access. This development follows directives from German authorities concerning user privacy and data handling practices by app developers.
